paragraphs: R' Yehudah son of R' Elazar. Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 21:7.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ויק״ר פ״כא־ז is expanded as Vayikra Rabbah 21:7, reading the divisions as parashah 21, section 7. This is the current contextual locator reading, not a freshly verified named edition; earlier machine OCR had פ״בא״ן.
בר׳ conveys “son of R'” here; it does not give either person a full Rabbi title. Both abbreviated personal-title components remain R', and no genealogy beyond this parentage is supplied.
